<title level="1" right="Spell 6" pfs="Standard">
[Field of Razors](/Spells.aspx?ID=1370)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 143

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Any spells which require metal to function require the PC to be holding at least one chunk of that metal or an item made of that metal._

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Area** 20-foot burst

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
[basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You grind a chunk of your choice of metal to fine dust between your hands and blow it into the air, where it grows into a tangle of wires covered in razor-sharp prongs. The metal must be of a type you currently have in your possession. The covered area is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453). A creature that moves through the area takes 5 slashing damage per square traversed.

 If a creature takes slashing, piercing, or [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) while inside the thicket, you can spend a reaction to grow the iron in the shed blood into additional wires, expanding the burst by 5 feet. You can grow the area four times in this way, to a maximum of a 40-foot burst. 

The barbed wires are made of the metal you chose and activate resistances, weaknesses, and the like normally. The metal reforms in your possession when the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage per square increases by 2.
name: Field of Razors
